yt_detail: Lasker's queen offer fails to stop the attack
title: Cambridge Springs Fire
description: Harry Nelson Pillsbury faces Emanuel Lasker in round 6 of the 1904 Cambridge Springs tournament. The game starts as a tense queen pawn battle, then turns into a race of activity, exposed kings, and loose material. Watch for the evaluation swing near move 19, then the queen sacrifice that the engine says keeps resistance alive. The final position shows why Pillsbury's coordination mattered.
